title: TASK-073.1 ST-1 - SWA model + checkpoint restore must emit one text
comment: TASK-073.1 ST-1: the same checkpoint-restore contract as tests/task073-mtp-paths.json, but on an SWA model with the speculative path removed. MTP off, so a drift here can only come from the checkpoint blob and the SWA ring. Kept in its own file so the TASK-073 ST-4 Groot matrix stays the production regression.

cells.note: gemma4 26B-A4B: sliding_window 1024 on 25 of 30 layers, MTP off, checkpoints at the product default
control: same weights and knobs, checkpoints disabled; isolates the checkpoint blob from everything else
